aiMachineReadReview.question: Starting from the new stable prefix index, how do I install Python Anki Forge and export a persistent first deck?
aiMachineReadReview.answer: The newly fetched [prefix llms](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/llms.txt) links to [the prefix Python quickstart](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/python-quickstart/index.md). Preserve namespace and note key for later updates. Anki is unnecessary for export. Canonical and continuation links retain `/anki-forge/`. This answer follows fresh HTTP reading, not a new installation or program execution.
